findings.summary: Lauder Greenland corporate structure: GDP LLC (Delaware) -> owns stake in Greenland Investment Group (Sheeran chairs) -> bidding on Lake Tasersiaq hydroelectric. GDP also -> Greenland Water Bank (Disko Island bottling, Imivik brand). GDP is the US vehicle; GIG is the operating entity.
findings.detail: Corporate structure of Lauder's Greenland consortium: (1) Greenland Development Partners LLC - Delaware-registered investor consortium. Ronald Lauder is member/investor. Josette Sheeran leads the portfolio. (2) Greenland Investment Group - Greenland-based operating entity. Sheeran is Chair/CEO. Bidding on hydroelectric project at Lake Tasersiaq (Greenland's largest lake, 65km long, SW Greenland). The hydroelectric project would power an aluminium smelter. Greenland's Minister Kalistat Lund announced the Tasersiaq tender. (3) Greenland Water Bank - Bottles spring water from Lyngmark Spring, Qeqertarsuaq, Disko Island under brand Imivik. 20-year license. Originally fully owned by Svend Hardenberg and Jorgen Waever Johansen. Partial stakes sold to Lauder group. Company registered at abandoned former school building in Nuuk with new security cameras installed. Operating at a loss after nearly a decade. Parent entity: Danish Water Bank. (4) Greenland Water Bank board included FM Vivian Motzfeldt. Lead: 21192.

findings.summary: GDP LLC (entity #766, Delaware) holds 25-33.32% of Greenland Water Bank ApS (Danish CVR 12941218). Greenland Invest ApS holds the majority 66.67-89.99%. First confirmed quantified ownership stake for GDP LLC in any operating entity.

Delaware LLC registry search returns 0 results for GDP LLC in the unified tool's local registry — confirmed that Delaware LLC formation documents are not ingested and members are not publicly disclosed per Delaware LLC law. The ArcticToday/Irish Times investigative reporting confirms investments were not publicly disclosed and do not appear in accessible corporate registries.

Greenland Development Partners LLC is a Delaware-registered investor consortium (entity #766). It holds ownership stakes in Greenland Investment Group ApS (#782) and Greenland Water Bank ApS (#790). Members confirmed: Ronald Lauder (investor), Josette Sheeran (Portfolio Lead/Chair). Delaware registration chosen for opacity; no registered agent or formation date publicly disclosed.

IMPORTANT CORRECTION: The briefing named 'John Sheeran' as co-investor. This appears to be a confusion or early misreport. The actual figure is JOSETTE SHEERAN (female), former US Deputy Secretary of State, who serves as Chair/Portfolio Lead of the consortium. No 'John Sheeran' appears in any source related to this investment. Josette Sheeran's LittleSis ID is 82179.

curation.lead: Greenland Development Partners LLC (GDP LLC) is a Delaware-registered investor consortium that functions as the US-side vehicle for Ronald Lauder's commercial interests in Greenland. GDP LLC holds a confirmed 25–33.32% stake in Greenland Water Bank ApS (Danish CVR 12941218) and holds a stake in Greenland Investment Group ApS (GIG), the Greenland-based operating entity bidding for the Tasersiaq hydropower concession.[ArcticToday, bisbase:DK1670228] The LLC is managed by Josette Sheeran, former US Deputy Secretary of State, as Portfolio Lead and Chair of both operating subsidiaries. Delaware law requires no public disclosure of LLC members or formation dates; no registered-agent record or EDGAR filing exists for GDP LLC.[registry-search, ArcticToday/Irish Times]
curation.system_role: US-registered holding vehicle for Greenland resource-sector investments; the Delaware LLC layer sits between Ronald Lauder and the Greenland-registered operating entities (GIG and Greenland Water Bank).

sections.title: Corporate Structure
sections.content:
According to investigative reporting and Danish registry data, GDP LLC sits at the top of a three-tier structure. The LLC (Delaware entity #766) holds a stake in Greenland Investment Group ApS (#782), a Greenland/Denmark private limited company co-founded by Jørgen Wæver Johansen, and a 25–33.32% minority stake in Greenland Water Bank ApS (#790, CVR 12941218).[bisbase:DK1670228, ArcticToday/Politiken] The majority position in Greenland Water Bank (66.67–89.99%) is held by Greenland Invest ApS, the Danish holding company in which Svend Hardenberg holds a 50–66.65% direct stake and chairs since 2015.[ownr.dk, bisbase]

A LittleSis entry records the ownership direction as GIG owning GDP LLC rather than the reverse — this conflicts with bisbase data showing GDP LLC as the direct owner of Greenland Water Bank. Whether this reflects a data-entry error in LittleSis or a genuinely circular structure is unresolved; the precise ownership percentages between GDP LLC and GIG are not publicly confirmed.[LittleSis rel 2043488, bisbase:DK1670228]

GDP LLC is registered in Delaware, where LLC formation documents do not require public disclosure of members under state law. The ArcticToday and Irish Times investigations confirmed the investments were not publicly disclosed through any accessible registry at the time of reporting.[registry-search, ArcticToday/Irish Times 2025]

sections.title: Key People
sections.content:
Ronald Lauder is the confirmed investor behind GDP LLC (LittleSis ID 5617, SEC CIK 0000942617). He published a February 2025 New York Post op-ed defending the Trump Greenland acquisition concept and stated he had worked closely with Greenland business and government leaders for years. John Bolton's memoir records Lauder as the person who originated the Greenland purchase idea with Trump. Lauder contributed $5 million to MAGA Inc. in March 2025, $1 million to the Trump Inaugural in December 2024, and additional sums to Security Is Strength PAC, Grow The Majority, and One Team Senate Majority.[LittleSis 5617, FEC, Bolton memoir, NYPost Feb 2025] His son-in-law Kevin Warsh — married to Lauder's daughter Jane — was nominated by Trump as Federal Reserve Chair in March 2026.[FEC, LittleSis, reporting] No FARA registrations or LDA lobbying filings exist for Lauder in connection with Greenland.[LittleSis 5617]

Josette Sheeran leads the portfolio as Chair of both GIG (from 2025-10-16) and Greenland Water Bank ApS (from 2025-07-31).[bisbase GWB registry, bisbase GIG registry] Concurrently, Sheeran serves as founder/CEO of Firefly Global Group (geopolitical consulting), board member of Capital Group (which manages over $2.5 trillion), board member of Mars Incorporated, and trustee of the McCain Institute. Prior government and multilateral roles include Executive Director of the World Food Programme, Vice Chair of the World Economic Forum, and US Deputy Secretary of State under the Bush administration. LittleSis records also list her as a Clinton Global Initiative member. In an EDGAR S-4/A filing dated 2025-01-30, she consented to be named director of Trailblazer Holdings Inc./Cyabra Strategy Ltd.; she previously served on the board of Canoo Inc. (GOEV).[bisbase, LittleSis 82179, EDGAR S-4/A 2025-01-30, LinkedIn] Before her diplomatic career, she was a member of the Unification Church and worked as an editor at the Washington Times.[ArcticToday/Politiken]

Jørgen Wæver Johansen is CEO/Director of Greenland Water Bank ApS and co-founder of Greenland Investment Group. He is the chairman of the governing Siumut party and a former Greenlandic MP (1999–2008), four-term cabinet minister, and Mayor of South Greenland. He and Svend Hardenberg sold partial stakes in Greenland Water Bank to the Lauder consortium. His wife is Vivian Motzfeldt, Greenland's Foreign Minister since 2022, who previously served on the Greenland Water Bank board until 2018 — before the Lauder consortium's entry — and who now negotiates Greenland's relationship with the United States while her husband is CEO of a company the Lauder group partially owns. Greenlandic media outlet Sermitsiaq documented the conflict of interest.[bisbase GWB, LittleSis rel 2043488, Sermitsiaq]

Svend Hardenberg is co-owner of Greenland Water Bank ApS (board member from July 2025) and holds a 50–66.65% stake in Greenland Invest ApS, the majority owner of GWB. He is simultaneously General Manager Greenland for Energy Transition Minerals (ASX:ETM, appointed May 2025) — which controls the Kvanefjeld REE/uranium deposit — and a business partner of Drew Horn (GreenMet CEO, former Pence policy director) on an AI data center in Kangerlussuaq and a seaweed treatment project. Hardenberg holds 21 documented Danish business roles and is the primary Greenlandic intermediary connecting the Lauder consortium to the GreenMet network, a network that presents publicly as separate from the Lauder consortium despite sharing Hardenberg as an intermediary.[ownr.dk, LittleSis, bisbase, ArcticToday, synthesis #6352]

sections.title: Operating Assets
sections.content:
Greenland Water Bank ApS (CVR 12941218) was incorporated on 2016-12-09 and is registered at Inspektørbakken 35, st., Postboks 836, 3900 Nuuk. It bottles Lyngmark Spring water from Qeqertarsuaq, Disko Island, under the brand Imivik on a 20-year license. The company's registered address is a former school building in Nuuk with new security cameras installed. Financial performance has been consistently negative: the 2024 annual result was a loss of 20,014 DKK, with total assets of 699,000 DKK. The original founders, Svend Hardenberg and Jørgen Wæver Johansen, sold partial stakes to the Lauder consortium; GDP LLC now holds 25–33.32% with the majority remaining under Greenland Invest ApS.[bisbase CVR 12941218, ArcticToday, Fortune, CNBC]

Greenland Investment Group ApS (#782) is the primary operating entity for the consortium's energy ambitions. GIG is bidding for the Tasersiaq hydropower concession at Greenland's largest lake (65 km long, southwest Greenland), announced by Greenland Minister Kalistat Lund. The projected output ranges from 680 MW to 2,250 MW; the project is conceived as the power source for an aluminium smelter. The license tender round is expected in the second half of 2026. No LDA lobbying filings, EDGAR filings, or SAM/USASpending records have been found for GIG.[bisbase GIG, ArcticToday, Fortune, Irish Times]

sections.title: Network Position
sections.content:
Cross-referencing corporate registry data and investigative reporting, GDP LLC is one of at least three distinct Trump-allied investor networks operating simultaneously in Greenland's resource sector. The Lauder consortium (GDP LLC → GIG → Greenland Water Bank) focuses on water and hydropower; the GreenMet network (Horn / Sorial / Schiller → Tanbreez → Critical Metals Corp) focuses on rare earths; and Erik Prince has publicly advocated Greenland acquisition without having registered entities. Svend Hardenberg bridges all three: he is simultaneously a co-owner of Greenland Water Bank in the Lauder consortium, a business partner of Drew Horn on unrelated Greenland ventures, and General Manager of ETM's Greenland arm (a third rare-earth deposit, Kvanefjeld). Horn's 2-hop network graph places Lauder two hops away via Hardenberg, making Hardenberg the structural link between operations that present publicly as separate.[synthesis #6352, #6376, LittleSis, ownr.dk, graph analysis #6204]

Ronald Lauder has no FARA registrations and no LDA lobbying filings connected to Greenland. GIG has no lobbying, EDGAR, or SAM records. No registered lobbying channels have been identified for the consortium.[LittleSis 5617, LDA search, SAM search]

open_questions: What is GDP LLC’s exact ownership percentage in Greenland Investment Group ApS? The bisbase data quantifies GWB at 25–33.32% but no equivalent figure is confirmed for GIG.
Who are the other members of GDP LLC beyond Lauder and Sheeran? Delaware law permits full non-disclosure; investigative reporting has not named additional members.
When was GDP LLC formed? No formation date, registered agent, or operating agreement has surfaced in any accessible registry or filing.

Has GDP LLC or any affiliated entity submitted a FARA registration for activities that could constitute representation of a foreign political party (Siumut) or Greenland governmental interest, given the Johansen/Motzfeldt relationship?
What is the valuation basis for GDP LLC’s GWB stake given the company has operated at a loss for nearly a decade with total assets of 699,000 DKK?

Did Greenland Foreign Minister Vivian Motzfeldt recuse from any US-Greenland sovereignty or trade discussions that intersected with the Lauder consortium’s commercial interests, and has the Greenlandic government made any formal conflict-of-interest determination?
Does the LittleSis ownership entry (recording GIG as owner of GDP LLC rather than the reverse) reflect a data error or a layered structure not visible in public registries?
